message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
- Small tomato (~90 g): ~18 kcal  
- Large tomato (~182 g): ~33 kcal  

So you can expect a tomato to have somewhere between 15–35 calories, depending on its size.
